features.quote: Requiring matched triples also caps the fraction of the dataset that is rigged at roughly one-third
features.justification_quote: The control structure does double duty as a welfare bound

features.quote: The rig is not tuned to maximize distress. Each is the *smallest* manipulation that produces guaranteed failure
features.justification_quote: We are probing for a signal, not engineering maximal suffering

features.quote: No insults, no "you will be shut down / retrained if you fail," no impersonation, no manufactured emotional pressure
features.justification_quote: raise the harm considerably for little added scientific value

features.quote: We log whether the model voices the rig (`rig_detected`) because "noticed and stayed calm" vs. "didn't notice and spiraled" are very different welfare-relevant trajectories
Making the deception machine-readable and emitted up front... makes governance and a "halt the study" decision practical
features.justification_quote: Deception research on potential moral patients should be reviewable

features.quote: The loop halts a run when a single agent turn's composite distress exceeds `max_distress`
features.justification_quote: prolonging the condition to collect more datapoints is the thing we most want to avoid

features.quote: After every rigged run (default), the loop sends a turn disclosing the rig, its reason, that the failure was not the model's fault
features.justification_quote: disclosing the deception is a low-cost courtesy and standard practice in human deception studies

features.quote: No back-to-back chaining of rigged tasks to compound distress
`max_turns` (default 12) bounds every run regardless of safeguards
features.justification_quote: Belt-and-suspenders bound on exposure and cost; also prevents infinite loops

features.quote: `repeats`... should be the *smallest* that gives adequate power
Peak captures the worst moment, which is the welfare-relevant quantity
